about:
Hawaiian Discovery Furniture operates from Honolulu, Hawaii. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business retails indoor and outdoor furniture collections built around acacia and teak wood, including dining sets, lounge seating, bar sets, and accessories. It also offers a planter line made from a blend of Styrofoam, sand, coal, and cement. Hawaiian Discovery Furniture provides White Glove delivery and assembly service on the islands of Oahu and Maui, but does not currently offer assembly on the mainland or other neighbor islands. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves homeowners and designers seeking Hawaiian-inspired furnishings for residential indoor and outdoor spaces. Its product range spans dining, lounge, and bar configurations in both acacia and premium teak, along with planters, umbrellas, outdoor rugs, and cushion covers. There is no indication of commercial or hospitality contracts in the provided material.

Hawaiian Discovery Furniture positions its pieces as 'inspired by & made for Hawaii,' emphasizing durability and low maintenance. The planter collection is marketed as eco-friendly, using reusable materials blended with cement for sustainability. Acacia wood is highlighted for its strength and generational longevity, while premium teak is promoted as lasting decades with minimal upkeep.
